hardware: Radeon 8060S / gfx1151 (Ryzen AI MAX+ PRO 395, 128 GiB unified, Desktop)

method.profiler: rocprofv3 (TheRock SDK), 3 passes: FETCH_SIZE | SQ_INSTS_VALU SQ_WAVES | GRBM_GUI_ACTIVE SQ_BUSY_CYCLES
method.timing: unprofiled probe wall, 50 iters after 3 warmup, device-synchronized (scripts/muse_glimmer_decode_attn_scale.py)
method.fetch_calibration: FETCH_SIZE in KB; previously calibrated 0.06% against a known single-read decode shape (gemma4 prefill roofline work); here within 2-6% of the K/V byte model at every point
method.roofline: 220 GB/s practical sustained-read ceiling for this host (probe default); theoretical LPDDR5X 256 GB/s

classification.ar_decode_tok1_ge_32k: DRAM-bandwidth-bound: 197-221 GB/s effective = 90-100% of the practical roofline; FETCH_SIZE ~= one K/V read (no re-fetch). No meaningful kernel-level headroom for AR decode attention at long context.
classification.ar_decode_tok1_4k: Latency/launch-bound (4.4x floor) but absolute cost tiny: 0.084 ms/layer, ~1.1 ms/step over 13 NoPE layers. Not worth chasing.
classification.verify_tok5: NOT bandwidth-bound: K/V fetch amortized to ~1x model at every context, yet 2.3-2.9x the single-row floor (77-94 GB/s effective). Residual is per-row compute/occupancy in the multi-row path. Only remaining attention-side lever; benefits DFlash verify. Upper-bound saving if row sharing reached the 1-row floor: 13 NoPE layers x (ms5-ms1) = 3.7 ms/verify at 32K, 10.6 at 131K, 20.2 at 260K.

caveats: SQ_INSTS_VALU/SQ_WAVES/GRBM_GUI_ACTIVE/SQ_BUSY_CYCLES absolute values are unreliable on this rocprofv3/gfx1151 combination (SQ_WAVES=19 for a 256-workgroup grid; GRBM_GUI_ACTIVE non-monotonic in kernel duration; 40 instance rows per dispatch). Relative VALU scaling (~row-count) is consistent. Classification therefore rests on calibrated FETCH_SIZE + unprofiled durations + roofline arithmetic, not activity-counter utilization.
PMC-mode dispatch timestamps underestimated the 32K tok=1 kernel (0.115 vs 0.152 ms unprofiled, implying an impossible 312 GB/s); unprofiled walls are authoritative for rates.
Isolated synthetic K/V probe, one NoPE-layer geometry; per-model figures multiply by 13 NoPE layers (SWA layers window-bounded).
verdict: Further AR decode-attention work cannot pay at long context (at the DRAM roof). The one attention-side candidate with headroom is multi-row verify sharing (tok>1), queued behind the target-prefill TTFT lever.
